//: Everything Jellyfin shows about the plugin. scripts/build-jellyfin-plugin.js writes it into the zip's meta.json and the repository manifest. version is used when no version is passed to the build.
name: Archive
overview: Move movies and shows into an archive or a soft delete library that stay out of the main library
description: Adds an archive and a soft delete library to Jellyfin. Chosen users get the button to move a title, chosen users can see each library, and Moonfin shows the buttons on the details screen.
changelog: Soft delete next to the archive, with separate rights for each button and each library.
